# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_VWAP_MEAN_REVERSION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price deviates sharply below VWAP while the EMA ribbon is bullish (8>21>34), short-term mean reversion to VWAP provides an edge. This occurs because extreme VWAP deviations often represent temporary pullbacks within a bullish intraday trend, and the EMA ribbon alignment filters for trend consistency to avoid countertrend trades.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** At bar close, if 8-EMA > 21-EMA > 34-EMA (bullish ribbon) AND close ≤ VWAP – 1×ATR(14), enter long at next bar's open.  
**Exit:**  
- Primary stop: Chart-stop at most recent swing low (structure invalidation)  
- Profit-taking: TP1 at 1.5×R (R = entry to chart-stop distance)  
- Runner management: After TP1 fill, trail remaining position at 10% below high-water-mark  
- Time stop: 15:50 ET
